description: This Java class provides functionality to open URLs in the user's default web browser, either via the java.awt.Desktop API or fallback OS-specific methods, with platform detection and error handling.

classes.name: BrowserControl
classes.description: Provides static methods to display URLs in the default web browser with platform-specific fallbacks.

methods.name: displayURL
methods.description: Attempts to open a URL in the system default browser using java.awt.Desktop; if that fails, falls back to a platform-specific method.

methods.name: displayURLtraditional
methods.description: Uses OS-specific commands to open a URL in the default browser when java.awt.Desktop API is unavailable.

methods.name: isWindowsPlatform
methods.description: Detects whether the current operating system is Windows based on system property 'os.name'.
